<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ur"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Royal Puzzle</title>
<style>
:root{box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);--gold:#f5c542}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{margin:0;background:#0d2c52;color:#fff;font-family:system-ui,"Noto Nastaliq Urdu",sans-serif;text-align:center}
#app{max-width:430px;margin:0 auto;padding:10px 10px 16px}
h1{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:26px;color:#ffd866;letter-spacing:1px}
.sub{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:3px;color:#f6e3a1;margin-bottom:8px}
.row{display:grid;gap:8px;margin:8px 0}
.card{background:linear-gradient(#fffaf0,#f1e4c5);color:#13294b;border-radius:14px;padding:7px 2px}
.card small{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;color:#a67a2a}
.card b{font-size:22px}
.gb{border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:11px 4px;background:linear-gradient(#ffd866,#f2b72a);color:#2a1d00;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #b07d10;font-family:inherit}
.bar{height:14px;border-radius:8px;background:#2f4f78;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid #ffd866}
.bar b{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fbe9a6,#d9a94e);transition:width .3s}
.ur{direction:rtl;color:#ffd866;font-size:15px;line-height:1.9;margin:6px 0 0}.ur2{direction:rtl;color:#cfe0f5;font-size:13px;margin:0 0 8px}
#bd{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:3px;padding:5px;background:#f0b429;border-radius:14px;touch-action:none;user-select:none}
.t{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:9px;background:#fbf3df;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .15s}
.t img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;pointer-events:none}
.t.s{outline:3px solid #1e6bff;transform:scale(1.08);z-index:1;position:relative}
.t.h{outline:3px solid #2ecc71}.t.p{animation:pp .28s forwards}
@keyframes pp{to{transform:scale(0);opacity:0}}
[hidden]{display:none!important}.big{width:100%;font-size:22px;padding:16px;margin:16px 0 8px}.fr{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin:14px 0}.fr img{width:15%;border-radius:10px}.how{background:#17406f;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 14px;margin:14px 0;text-align:left;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}.how h3{margin:0 0 4px;color:#ffd866;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:1px}.how p{margin:4px 0}.gc{background:linear-gradient(#fffaf0,#f1e4c5);color:#13294b;border-radius:18px;padding:14px;margin:16px 0;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #b07d10}.gc b{display:block;font-size:20px;margin-top:10px}.gc small{color:#a67a2a;font-weight:700}
.pv{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center}.pv img,.pv i{width:28%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:10px}.pv i{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#1e4d8a;border:3px solid #ffd866;box-sizing:border-box;font-style:normal;font-size:24px}
.mb{display:grid;gap:8px;padding:8px;background:#17406f;border-radius:14px}.mc{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer}.mc .fc{display:none;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}.fr .fi{width:15%;aspect-ratio:1}.pv .fi{width:28%;aspect-ratio:1}.mc .fc img,.fi img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.mc .bk{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e4d8a,#0d2c52);border:3px solid #ffd866;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:clamp(22px,8vw,36px);box-sizing:border-box}
.mc.o .bk{display:none}.mc.o .fc{display:block;animation:fl .25s}.mc.m{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #2ecc71;border-radius:12px}@keyframes fl{from{transform:rotateY(90deg)}to{transform:none}}
.ad{display:none;margin-top:12px;border:1px dashed #6f8db5;border-radius:6px;padding:12px 0;font-size:11px;color:#9db6d6}
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000b;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;z-index:9}
.box{background:#fffaf0;color:#13294b;border-radius:20px;padding:22px;width:100%;max-width:300px}.box .gb{width:100%;font-size:15px;margin-top:8px}
</style></head><body><div id="app"><div id="hub"><h1 style="font-size:32px;margin-top:28px">👑 ROYAL PUZZLE</h1><div class="sub">CHOOSE YOUR GAME</div>
<div class="gc" onclick="show('home')"><div class="pv" id="p1"></div><b>DRY FRUITS MATCH</b><small>Swap and match 3 or more</small></div>
<div class="gc" onclick="show('mhome')"><div class="pv" id="p2"></div><b>MEMORY MATCH</b><small>Flip cards and find the pairs</small></div>
<div class="ad">Banner ad (AdMob)</div></div>
<div id="home" hidden><div style="text-align:left"><button class="gb" style="padding:8px 12px" onclick="toHub()">‹ ALL GAMES</button></div><h1 style="font-size:32px;margin-top:28px">👑 ROYAL PUZZLE</h1><div class="sub">DRY FRUITS MATCH GAME</div>
<div id="fr" class="fr"></div>
<button class="gb big" onclick="play()">▶ PLAY</button>
<div class="row" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)"><button class="gb" onclick="soon()">🎁 DAILY GIFT</button><button class="gb" onclick="soon()">🎬 FREE COINS</button></div>
<button class="gb" style="width:100%" onclick="soundOn=!soundOn;this.textContent=soundOn?'🔊 SOUND ON':'🔇 SOUND OFF'">🔊 SOUND ON</button>
<div class="how"><h3>HOW TO PLAY</h3><p>Match 3 or more identical dry fruits in a row or column.</p><p>Tap two neighbouring tiles to swap them, or swipe a tile toward its neighbour.</p><p>Only neighbouring tiles can be swapped. Reach the target score before time runs out.</p></div>
<div class="ad">Banner ad (AdMob)</div></div>
<div id="mhome" hidden><div style="text-align:left"><button class="gb" style="padding:8px 12px" onclick="toHub()">‹ ALL GAMES</button></div>
<h1 style="font-size:32px;margin-top:20px">👑 MEMORY MATCH</h1><div class="sub">FIND ALL THE PAIRS</div><div id="fr2" class="fr"></div>
<button class="gb big" onclick="mplay()">▶ PLAY</button>
<button class="gb" style="width:100%" onclick="soundOn=!soundOn;this.textContent=soundOn?'🔊 SOUND ON':'🔇 SOUND OFF'">🔊 SOUND ON</button>
<div class="how"><h3>HOW TO PLAY</h3><p>In level 1 the cards are shown for 3 seconds, then they flip face down. From level 2 they start face down.</p><p>Tap two cards to flip them. Matching pairs stay open.</p><p>Find every pair before time runs out. Fewer moves and more time left earn more stars.</p><p>Levels never end. After 16 cards, every new level gets a little faster.</p></div>
<div class="ad">Banner ad (AdMob)</div></div>
<div id="mem" hidden><h1>👑 MEMORY MATCH</h1><div class="sub">FIND ALL THE PAIRS</div>
<div class="row" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)"><div class="card"><small>LEVEL</small><b id="ml">1</b></div><div class="card"><small>TIME</small><b id="mtm">0</b></div><div class="card"><small>MOVES</small><b id="mmv">0</b></div><div class="card"><small>PAIRS</small><b id="mpr">0</b></div></div>
<div class="row" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)"><button class="gb" onclick="mpz()">⏸ PAUSE</button><button class="gb" onclick="mstart(ml)">↻ RESTART</button><button class="gb" onclick="mHome()">🏠 HOME</button></div>
<div id="mb" class="mb"></div><div class="ad">Banner ad (AdMob)</div></div>
<div id="game" hidden>
<h1>👑 ROYAL PUZZLE</h1><div class="sub">DRY FRUITS MATCH GAME</div>
<div class="row" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)">
<div class="card"><small>SCORE</small><b id="sc">0</b></div><div class="card"><small>LEVEL</small><b id="lv">1</b></div>
<div class="card"><small>TARGET</small><b id="tg">1000</b></div><div class="card"><small>TIME</small><b id="tm">240</b></div></div>
<div class="bar"><b id="pb"></b></div>
<div class="row" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)"><div class="card"><small>MOVES</small><b id="mv">0</b></div><div class="card"><small>BEST SCORE</small><b id="bs">0</b></div></div>
<div class="row" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)">
<button class="gb" onclick="shuf()">🔀 SHUFFLE</button><button class="gb" onclick="hnt()">💡 HINT</button>
<button class="gb" onclick="pz()">⏸ PAUSE</button><button class="gb" onclick="newGame()">↻ NEW GAME</button></div>
<div id="bd"></div>
<div class="ad">Banner ad (AdMob)</div></div></div>
<script>
const IM=["data:image/jpeg;base64,", "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "data:image/jpeg;base64,"];
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)),rnd=n=>Math.floor(Math.random()*n);
const C=7,R=8,K=6;let g=[],sc=0,lvl=1,tg=1000,time=240,soundOn=true,mv=0,best=0,sel=-1,busy=false,paused=false,over=false,pop=new Set(),hint=[],gen=0,tm=0,ac;
function snd(f,d=.1){if(!soundOn)return;try{ac=ac||new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();const o=ac.createOscillator(),v=ac.createGain();o.frequency.value=f;v.gain.value=.12;o.connect(v);v.connect(ac.destination);o.start();v.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,ac.currentTime+d);o.stop(ac.currentTime+d)}catch(e){}}
function find(){const s=new Set();for(let r=0;r<R;r++)for(let c=0;c<C;c++){const i=r*C+c,v=g[i];if(v<0)continue;if(c<C-2&&v==g[i+1]&&v==g[i+2]){s.add(i);s.add(i+1);s.add(i+2)}if(r<R-2&&v==g[i+C]&&v==g[i+2*C]){s.add(i);s.add(i+C);s.add(i+2*C)}}return s}
function move(){for(let i=0;i<C*R;i++)for(const j of[i+1,i+C]){if(j>=C*R||(j==i+1&&j%C==0))continue;[g[i],g[j]]=[g[j],g[i]];const f=find().size;[g[i],g[j]]=[g[j],g[i]];if(f)return[i,j]}return null}
function fresh(){do{g=Array.from({length:C*R},()=>rnd(K))}while(find().size||!move())}
function d(){$('#sc').textContent=sc;$('#lv').textContent=lvl;$('#tg').textContent=tg;$('#tm').textContent=time;$('#mv').textContent=mv;$('#bs').textContent=best;$('#pb').style.width=Math.min(100,sc/tg*100)+'%';
 $('#bd').innerHTML=g.map((v,i)=>`<div class="t${i==sel?' s':''}${pop.has(i)?' p':''}${hint.includes(i)?' h':''}" data-i="${i}">${v>=0?`<img src="${IM[v]}" alt="">`:''}</div>`).join('')}
async function res(my){let f,cb=0;while((f=find()).size){cb++;pop=f;snd(450+cb*90,.15);d();await sleep(280);if(my!=gen)return;f.forEach(i=>g[i]=-1);sc+=f.size*10*cb;best=Math.max(best,sc);pop=new Set();
 for(let c=0;c<C;c++){const col=[];for(let r=R-1;r>=0;r--)if(g[r*C+c]>=0)col.push(g[r*C+c]);while(col.length<R)col.push(rnd(K));for(let r=0;r<R;r++)g[(R-1-r)*C+c]=col[r]}d();await sleep(240);if(my!=gen)return}}
function tap(i){if(busy||paused||over)return;hint=[];if(sel<0){sel=i;snd(400,.05);d();return}
 const adj=Math.abs(Math.floor(i/C)-Math.floor(sel/C))+Math.abs(i%C-sel%C)==1;if(adj){const a=sel;sel=-1;swap(a,i)}else{sel=i;d()}}
async function swap(a,i){if(busy||paused||over)return;hint=[];busy=true;const my=gen;[g[a],g[i]]=[g[i],g[a]];d();await sleep(150);
 if(find().size){mv++;await res(my);if(my!=gen){busy=false;return}if(sc>=tg)lvUp();else if(!move())fresh();d()}
 else{[g[a],g[i]]=[g[i],g[a]];snd(180,.1);d()}busy=false}
let ps=null;const bd=$('#bd');
bd.onpointerdown=e=>{const t=e.target.closest('.t');ps=t?{i:+t.dataset.i,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,done:false}:null};
bd.onpointermove=e=>{if(!ps||ps.done)return;const dx=e.clientX-ps.x,dy=e.clientY-ps.y;if(Math.max(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dy))<16)return;ps.done=true;
 const i=ps.i,c=i%C,r=Math.floor(i/C);let j=null;
 if(Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)){if(dx>0&&c<C-1)j=i+1;else if(dx<0&&c>0)j=i-1}else{if(dy>0&&r<R-1)j=i+C;else if(dy<0&&r>0)j=i-C}
 if(j!=null){sel=-1;swap(i,j)}};
bd.onpointerup=()=>{if(ps&&!ps.done)tap(ps.i);ps=null};bd.onpointercancel=()=>{ps=null};
const rm=()=>{const x=$('#ov');x&&x.remove()};
function ov(t,m,b){rm();const x=document.createElement('div');x.className='ov';x.id='ov';x.innerHTML=`<div class="box"><h2>${t}</h2><p>${m}</p>${b.map(([l,f])=>`<button class="gb" onclick="${f}">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;document.body.appendChild(x)}
function lvUp(){paused=true;snd(880,.4);ov('🎉 Level complete',`Score: ${sc}`,[['Next level','nextLv()']])}
function nextLv(){rm();lvl++;tg+=400;sc=0;time=tl();sel=-1;fresh();paused=false;d()}
function newGame(){rm();gen++;lvl=1;tg=1000;sc=0;mv=0;time=tl();sel=-1;hint=[];busy=false;paused=false;over=false;pop=new Set();fresh();d();clearInterval(tm);
 tm=setInterval(()=>{if(paused||over)return;time--;if(time<=0){time=0;over=true;snd(150,.5);ov('⏰ Time up',`Score: ${sc}`,[['New game','newGame()']])}$('#tm').textContent=time},1000)}
function shuf(){if(busy||paused||over)return;sel=-1;fresh();d()}
function hnt(){if(busy||paused||over)return;hint=move()||[];d();setTimeout(()=>{hint=[];if(!busy)d()},1800)}
function pz(){if(over)return;paused=true;ov('⏸ Paused','',[['Resume','paused=false;rm()'],['Home','goHome()']])}
const tl=()=>Math.min(360,240+(lvl-1)*15);
function show(id){['hub','home','mhome','mem','game'].forEach(x=>$('#'+x).hidden=x!=id)}
function play(){show('game');newGame()}
function goHome(){rm();clearInterval(tm);gen++;paused=false;show('home')}
function toHub(){rm();clearInterval(tm);clearInterval(mt);gen++;mg++;paused=false;show('hub')}
function soon(){ov('Coming soon','This feature will work in the full app.',[['OK','rm()']])}
const FI=["data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,"];
const fsv=i=>`<img src="${FI[i]}" alt="">`;
const PR=l=>Math.min(8,l+2),MCOL={6:3,8:4,10:5,12:4,14:5,16:4},MTM=l=>l<=6?[40,55,70,85,100,110][l-1]:Math.max(45,110-(l-6)*5);
let ml=1,mtime=0,mmv=0,mfound=0,mopen=[],mlock=true,mpaused=false,mt=0,mg=0,mcards=[],mT=0;
function mplay(){show('mem');mstart(1)}
function mh(){$('#ml').textContent=ml;$('#mtm').textContent=mtime;$('#mmv').textContent=mmv;$('#mpr').textContent=mfound+'/'+PR(ml)}
function mHome(){rm();clearInterval(mt);mg++;show('mhome')}
function mpz(){mpaused=true;ov('⏸ Paused','',[['Resume','mpaused=false;rm()'],['Home','mHome()']])}
function mstart(l){rm();ml=l;mg++;clearInterval(mt);const P=PR(l),my=mg;mT=MTM(l);mtime=mT;mmv=0;mfound=0;mopen=[];mpaused=false;mlock=true;
 const idx=[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5).slice(0,P);mcards=[...idx,...idx].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5);
 $('#mb').style.gridTemplateColumns=`repeat(${MCOL[P*2]},1fr)`;
 $('#mb').innerHTML=mcards.map((v,i)=>`<div class="mc${l==1?' o':''}" data-i="${i}"><div class="bk">👑</div><div class="fc">${fsv(v)}</div></div>`).join('');mh();
 const go=()=>{if(my!=mg)return;document.querySelectorAll('.mc').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('o'));mlock=false;
  mt=setInterval(()=>{if(mpaused)return;mtime--;mh();if(mtime<=0){clearInterval(mt);mlock=true;snd(150,.5);ov('⏰ Time up',`Pairs found: ${mfound}/${P}`,[['Try again','mstart(ml)'],['Home','mHome()']])}},1000)};
 if(l==1)setTimeout(go,3000);else go()}
$('#mb').onclick=async e=>{const c=e.target.closest('.mc');if(!c||mlock||mpaused)return;const i=+c.dataset.i;if(mopen.includes(i)||c.classList.contains('m'))return;
 c.classList.add('o');mopen.push(i);snd(440,.06);
 if(mopen.length==2){mmv++;mh();const[a,b]=mopen,cs=document.querySelectorAll('.mc'),my=mg;
  if(mcards[a]==mcards[b]){cs[a].classList.add('m');cs[b].classList.add('m');mopen=[];snd(660,.2);mfound++;mh();
   if(mfound==PR(ml)){clearInterval(mt);mlock=true;const s=mtime>mT*.5?3:mtime>mT*.25?2:1;snd(880,.4);
    ov('🎉 Level complete','⭐'.repeat(s)+'☆'.repeat(3-s)+`<br>Moves: ${mmv}`,[['Next level','mstart(ml+1)'],['Play again','mstart(ml)'],['Home','mHome()']])}}
  else{mlock=true;await sleep(750);if(my!=mg)return;cs[a].classList.remove('o');cs[b].classList.remove('o');mopen=[];mlock=false}}};
$('#p1').innerHTML=[0,1,2].map(k=>`<img src="${IM[k]}" alt="">`).join('');
$('#p2').innerHTML=`<div class="fi">${fsv(3)}</div><i>👑</i><div class="fi">${fsv(3)}</div>`;
$('#fr2').innerHTML=[2,3,4,5,6,7].map(k=>`<div class="fi">${fsv(k)}</div>`).join('');
$('#fr').innerHTML=IM.map(s=>`<img src="${s}" alt="">`).join('');
</script><script type="application/octet-stream" id="appicon"></script></body></html>
